title: Slope-state bucket conditioning (term-structure steepness states) on living vol ETP legs

blindness_declaration.law: D1 outcome-blind proposal: no outcome measurement, no returns conditional on states, no expectancies, no signal arithmetic on prices or indices beyond structural facts already committed in P0/P1/P2 artifacts. Every numeric leaf below is a committed structural fact cited from a sha256-pinned P0/P1/P2 artifact and appears only under committed_citations, representation_identity or feasibility_citation.
blindness_declaration.parameters_symbolic_until: D2/S (frozen before any scored number is seen; no threshold may move after any scored number)

mechanism.narrative: VIX-complex roll-yield gravity. Spot VIX is an untradeable synthetic of two SPX option strips; the tradeable complex (VIX futures and the ETPs that hold the rolling futures stack) must converge to it at every expiry. When the curve is in contango (near tenor below far tenor), each front future sits below the months it must deliver into and is dragged upward by expiry convergence: every persistent holder of front-of-curve long-vol exposure pays that roll continuously. The payment is mechanical gravity, not a forecast.
mechanism.forced_participant: The VIX-complex roll-yield gravity forces the ETP issuer, who must roll the front futures stack regardless of view to deliver the fund mandate (VXX-like long-vol legs roll unconditionally), and forces the persistent tail hedger, who demands front-of-curve protection and must keep paying the roll to keep it. ETP NAV convergence to the roll mechanics is mandatory, not chosen.
mechanism.late_participant: Post-spike entrants who buy long-vol ETPs only after a volatility event has already printed and then donate the steep-contango decay; ETP creation/redemption flow chases the vol level and therefore arrives late, after the roll-payment regime is already established.
mechanism.claim_declared_blind: States of the term-structure SLOPE itself (relative closes across the VIX9D/VIX/VIX3M tenors) identify intervals in which this forced roll-payment flow is largest and most persistent; the persistence of the forced flow, not any directional forecast of the index, is what could support conditioning tradeable ETP legs. Whether it does is exactly what D2 measures; nothing here is measured now.
mechanism.economic_magnitude_honesty: Declared honestly: the P2 worst-case round-trip cost ceilings at the primary stress tier (cited numerically under feasibility_citation) are on the order of two thousand basis points on the SHORT-bucket legs. Any mechanism that survives must be economically LARGE relative to those bounds. Small slope contrasts are declared uninteresting a priori; the family dies cheap if the state contrast cannot plausibly clear the ladder.

decision_rule_family.state_definition_symbolic: S_t = a fixed symbolic functional of the SAME-SESSION closes of the VIX9D, VIX and VIX3M index series (the term-structure slope functional, e.g. a signed log-ratio combination; the exact functional is frozen at D2/S before any scored number). STATE_t = bucket of S_t in {steep, mild, flat, inverted} at symbolic thresholds theta_1, theta_2.
decision_rule_family.action_map_symbolic: Each slope bucket maps to a symbolic position {long short-vol leg, long long-vol leg, flat} on a symbolic subset of the living event-adjusted ETP legs, with a symbolic minimum-holding h_min that limits round trips.
decision_rule_family.parameter_law: ALL parameters symbolic until D2/S; frozen before any scored number; no numeric thresholds are declared at D1.
decision_rule_family.arm_law: Arms must respect the frozen rubric cell budget (families x arms bounded, pairwise distinct arm_config_digest).

representation_identity.p12_note: Representation identity per P-12: the decision grid, series consumption law and decision-instant law are all committed pre-D2, sha256-cited; code AND representation are committed before any number is cited.

common_grid.coverage_convention: primary coverage is the gated convention; the full-window secondary variant disclosed in the P2 gate is never gated

why_information_differs.v16_close_displace_fade: the shadow forms act on the first-difference of a SINGLE instrument's close and fade the displacement; this proposal's state is the cross-tenor SHAPE of an options-implied index curve (relative closes across three tenors simultaneously) -- a different state object, and the declared mechanism is persistent forced flow, not a displacement fade. D2 tests the claim by pooling this proposal against v16 forms at the frozen ancestry margin.
why_information_differs.v17_oi_level: the shadow is a derivative open-interest LEVEL form; the frozen consumption set contains no options chain and no open-interest series of any kind (EODHD family-2 explicitly not entitled), so this proposal's information cannot be an OI re-clock. D2 tests the claim by ancestry pooling.
why_information_differs.dvol_shock: the shadow is a realized derivative-shock form on a different asset complex; this proposal consumes only official CBOE index closes and event-adjusted ETP closes -- no derivative shock series exists in the consumption set. D2 tests the claim by ancestry pooling.
why_information_differs.momentum_63s: the shadow is long-horizon single-series price momentum on an instrument level; this proposal's states are short-memory, curve-relative and computed on the index term structure rather than on any ETP NAV series. The index-only shadow control additionally separates index-state information from ETP-NAV behaviour. D2 tests the claim.
why_information_differs.generic_dow_tue: the shadow is a calendar day-of-week effect; the calendar-clock shadow control in control_battery_spec forces the rule to survive a weekday re-clock, and the placebo destroys temporal structure while matching marginals.

ancestry_risk_statement.d2_test_of_claim: pooled ancestry |rho| within the frozen rubric margin against the full pooled inventory INCLUDING every shadow named above; margin recorded per rubric; failure is a D2 VETO, recorded, never argued away.

control_battery_spec.battery_law: the battery must be runnable on the frozen representation with the invalid-null distinction recorded (frozen rubric); the mandatory controls are vetoes, not suggestions (plan section 1 a+b).

index_only_shadow.spec: the identical decision rule driven by the vol index series ALONE (VIX9D/VIX/VIX3M closes, same symbolic buckets), with the resulting placement re-clocked onto the ETP legs and no ETP price anywhere in the state. If the ETP-leg placement is not distinct from its own index re-clock, the ETP leg adds nothing and the proposal dies as an index re-clock.

cost_path_control.spec: the rule must survive the measured path-cost ladder, not a vendor-stated one: measured execution spreads at the stress tier scaling through the committed tier ladder with the primary tier at the top, cost once per fill, and the Q-16 roll/decay path component carried explicitly at every tier (per-leg path formulas and adverse tails as committed in the frozen cost contract and the P2 gate). Kill before selection if any arm fails the ladder (frozen rubric: cost ceiling kill before selection).

calendar_clock_shadow.spec: the same decision rule re-clocked to a fixed weekday shift (symbolic shift k sessions, frozen at D2/S): a generic_dow_tue detector. A placement that survives the re-clock unchanged is a calendar artefact and dies.

placebo.spec: the slope-state series is time-shuffled with matched marginals and destroyed temporal ordering; the placement induced by the placebo series must be indistinguishable from chance. A significant differential placement under the placebo kills the proposal.

control_battery_spec.invalid_null_distinction: an uncomputable state (warmup, refused tail, missing session) is INVALID and refused fail-closed; it is never coerced to NULL/flat and never scored as a decision (Q-11).

feasibility_citation.ceiling_note: worst-case COST CEILINGS at the primary stress tier; bounds, not expectations, not PnL numbers (Q-6 no-PnL law). Declared honestly: any surviving mechanism must be economically LARGE relative to these bounds.

falsification_rule.rule: PREREGISTERED KILL (one concrete condition): at D2, if the primary NET book of this proposal's slope-bucket placement -- measured on the P2 bookable grid against event-adjusted ETP legs, after the FULL measured path-cost ladder at the primary stress tier with the Q-16 roll/decay component included -- has after-cost expectancy at or below zero, this proposal is KILLED and recorded as VOL_NG1_REJECT_ALL evidence. Gross-only performance never rescues a killed proposal. No threshold moves after any scored number is seen.
